accept.description: what finishing this means — written when the work is asked for, not after

blocked.description: something outside the graph is in the way. Not a status: a blocked task is still open work.

on.description: what it is waiting on, in words

cancelled.description: the mark on a task that was called off

by.description: who called it off — kept as history when that entity is deleted

via.description: what the write came in through — the session or client that made it

contains.description: that task is part of this one

requires.description: this task waits for that one

task_new.title: Create a task
task_new.description: Create a task: a stored record with task{} and doc{title, body} field groups. It is open because it has neither a completed nor a cancelled mark. Pass a project, priority, assignee or domain and it gets a filed{} group holding those filing fields too. Returns the applied bundles: JSON objects with entity ids and the components (named groups of fields) written or removed.

title.description: what to do, in one line

body.description: what is being asked for, plus pointers to the details, as markdown

project.description: the project to file it under; pass its id or registered name

priority.description: queue order; lower is more urgent

assignee.description: id or registered name of the person or agent whose queue it goes in

check.description: rehearse the write and roll it back, returning the resolved task without saving it

task_list.title: List tasks
task_list.description: List the tasks a query selects, as bundles: JSON objects with entity ids and component fields. `.task` is always part of the query and narrows the whole of yours; with no query, `.task.status=open` is used. Use filters of the form .component.property=value joined with &: `.task.status=done`, `.filed.project=P-19`, `.filed.priority<3`, or a bare word to match text.

task_update.title: Update a task
task_update.description: Change a task’s status, title, body or filing. `status` is not a stored field: done adds the completed mark and removes the cancelled one, cancelled does the reverse, and open removes both. Anything left out is unchanged. Returns the applied bundles: JSON objects with entity ids and the components (named groups of fields) written or removed.

task.description: the task to change; pass its id or registered name

status.description: the new status: open, done or cancelled

project.description: the project to file it under; pass its id or registered name

priority.description: queue order; lower is more urgent

assignee.description: id or registered name of the person or agent whose queue it goes in

decision.description: A task asking a question, with choices and the asker’s recommendation. Open work requiring it makes it blocking; no such edge makes it eventual.

choices.description: Two to four choices, each a label and a line saying what it means.

recommended.description: The label of the choice the asker recommends.

decision_new.title: Ask a decision
decision_new.description: Ask a question as a task wearing decision{question, choices, recommended}. Give two to four labelled choices with descriptions and recommend one by label. Assign it to the person being asked. Work that requires it waits until it is answered; otherwise it is eventual. Returns applied bundles.

choices.description: Two to four choices, each a label and a line saying what it means.

project.description: the project to file it under; pass its id or registered name

priority.description: queue order; lower is more urgent

assignee.description: id or registered name of the person or agent whose queue it goes in

decision_answer.title: Answer a decision
decision_answer.description: Answer with a listed choice’s label or your own words. Records decided{choice} attributed to the caller, completes the task, and releases work requiring it. An answered or cancelled decision refuses another answer. Returns applied bundles.

decision.description: The decision task to answer; its id or registered name.

choice.description: A listed label or a custom answer.

decision_answered.description: An answered decision finishes its task, so work requiring it can proceed.
